subject: Isolated deployment validation & install test-plan Q&A
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ironcladsec.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Zhou <pzhou@ironcladsec.com>, procure@ironcladsec.com
Date: 2027-07-08T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Isolated deployment validation & install scenarios

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this on — IronClad is preparing an air-gapped production install of a 3-node Redwood cluster behind strict egress controls. Attached is our isolation_requirements.pdf and a short appendix with networking constraints. Two asks to start: 1) can you confirm Redwood supports an entirely offline bootstrap (no outbound internet) for initial install and key material provisioning; 2) please provide a conservative list of required ports/protocols and a POC test plan we can run in our staging air-gapped environment.

High-level constraints:
- No outbound HTTP/HTTPS to public registries allowed during install; mirrored registry ok
- Hardware HSM (Thales) present for master key custody
- Internal PKI with offline CA is available
- NTP must be internal only (no public NTP)

We'd like a written test plan and a checklist we can hand to our infra team — items must be automated where possible. Could you also call out any kernel/container runtime requirements or special network routes (e.g. mTLS endpoints that must be reachable inside the enclave)?

Patricia (platform security) and procurement are on cc — procurement will want a scoped SOW after we validate the feasibility.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Platform Security, IronClad Security
Attachments: isolation_requirements.pdf, IronClad_Network_Appendix.docx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ironcladsec.com>
Cc: Patricia Zhou <pzhou@ironcladsec.com>, procure@ironcladsec.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-08T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated deployment validation & install scenarios

Alex — thanks for the context and the appendix. We can support a fully offline bootstrap; below is a concise POC/test-plan draft and the minimal network/service requirements for an air-gapped install. I attached our redwood-offline-install-guide.pdf and a starter sandbox-test-cases.csv with runnable checks.

Quick summary (POC scope):
- Validate offline container registry mirroring and signed image verification
- Provisioning of initial control-plane keys via customer HSM (Thales) key-wrapping workflow
- Confirm startup with internal NTP and no public DNS resolution
- End-to-end inference test using synthetic prompt set (latency + correctness)

Minimal ports/protocols (conservative):
- 22/tcp (SSH) — admin only, bastion recommended
- 2379/tcp (etcd) — cluster internal only
- 10250-10255/tcp (kubelet/kube-proxy) — cluster internal
- 443/tcp (mTLS) — internal service mesh endpoints (cluster-only)
- 9000/tcp (model runtime admin API) — internal only
- NTP (123/udp) — internal NTP servers only

Notes on bootstrap:
- We support pulling images from a customer-hosted registry or a mirrored OCI registry tarball (offline import). All images must be signed; Redwood verifies signatures against provided root keys.
- KMS/HSM: we support an HSM-backed KMS workflow where master keys never leave the HSM. For air-gapped installs we perform an offline key-wrapping ceremony (documented in the install guide).
- Time sync and consistent hostnames are critical for certificate validation — include these checks in preflight.

Proposed POC timeline:
- Week 0: Exchange environment inventory and mirrored registry snapshots
- Week 1: Run preflight checks and bootstrap in staging air-gapped environment
- Week 2: Execute validation tests and hand over runbook/attestation artifacts

Next steps: can you confirm whether your mirrored registry will be an OCI registry accessible inside the enclave or delivered as tarballs? Also, please share Thales HSM interface details (PKCS#11 module name, firmware/firmware version) so we can validate compatibility.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-offline-install-guide.pdf, sandbox-test-cases.csv
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ironcladsec.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Zhou <pzhou@ironcladsec.com>, procure@ironcladsec.com
Date: 2027-07-09T09:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated deployment validation & install scenarios

Thanks Soojin — helpful. Clarifications from our side:
- Registry: will be a local Harbor OCI registry inside the enclave; ops will seed it from an air-gapped build pipeline (tar import is possible but less desirable)
- HSM: Thales Luna 8K, currently running firmware 4.2.1, exposing PKCS#11. We expect customer keys to be generated in-HSM and never exported.
- We also require an attestation artifact (signed SLSA-style provenance) for the images used during POC. Will Redwood verify and consume image provenance metadata as part of install preflight?

One more ask: procurement would like a short list of attestations/evidence Redwood can provide post-POC (logs, audit trail, signed manifests) plus any SOC2/ISO references you can point to. Patricia — do you want us to attach the internal evidence matrix?

Alex
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ironcladsec.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-10T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated deployment validation & install scenarios

On Fri, Jul 9, 2027 at 09:47 AM Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ironcladsec.com> wrote:
> One more ask: procurement would like a short list of attestations/evidence Redwood can provide post-POC (logs, audit trail, signed manifests) plus any SOC2/ISO references you can point to.

Alex — quick technical response plus evidence list. We can confirm the following:

Technical: 
- PKCS#11 (Thales) supported for wrapping/unwrapping master keys. Redwood's offline-ceremony supports HSM-resident key generation and uses key-wrapping so wrapped keys are imported into the cluster without ever exporting plaintext.
- Image provenance: Redwood can validate signed image manifests (Cosign) and consume OPA-style policies during preflight; we will fail the install if provenance verification fails.
- No mandatory outbound connectivity required for runtime. Optional telemetry can be enabled post-install via an approved relay inside the customer's network.

Evidence we provide (post-POC deliverables):
- Bootstrap attestation package (signed manifest of images, checksums, and preflight log)
- Audit trail of the install ceremony (timestamped steps, operator IDs)
- Container image signature verification report (Cosign verification entries)
- Runtime access logs and token exchange records (scrubbed of PII) for the POC window
- SOC2 Type II report and ISO 27001 scope document (we will provide redacted PDFs and can send an NDA'd package if needed)

Operational caveats / asks from IronClad: 
- Please provide the PKCS#11 module binary and a test HSM token so we can run an integration test during Week 0. If that is not possible, provide the HSM vendor test harness and credentials for a staging appliance.
- Confirm the internal NTP and DNS entries and whether outbound time sync/OCSP is allowed at all for the lifecycle window. If OCSP is blocked, we'll rely on CRL or embedded cert chains for the POC.

Marissa (cc) — happy to align on SOW scope lines (week estimates above). I recommend a 3-day onsite/remote workshop during bootstrap to speed validation.

-Vivek
Director, Applied ML & Inference Systems
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@ironcladsec.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Patricia Zhou <pzhou@ironcladsec.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procure@ironcladsec.com
Date: 2027-07-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Isolated deployment validation & install scenarios

Alex / Patricia — thanks for the details. Attached is a consolidated POC test plan and an install-checklist.xlsx that maps each preflight check to a verification artifact we will deliver. Key next steps:

1) IronClad to confirm mirrored registry type (Harbor OCI) and provide mirror credentials or an OCI bundle by July 15
2) Provide PKCS#11 module and a way for us to run a connectivity/integration test (staging token or lab appliance) week of July 19
3) Book a 3-day technical workshop (remote) between July 26-30 for bootstrap and first validation run
4) Procurement: we'll prepare a narrow SOW and a draft SAML/data-processing addendum — Marissa will follow up with the commercial terms and the DocuSign SOW link.

Deliverables we will send after POC: signed bootstrap attestation, preflight logs, image provenance report, and a short runbook for ongoing maintenance. For compliance docs (SOC2/ISO) we can send redacted reports under NDA; procurement, please advise on the preferred NDA flow.

I'll open a HubSpot deal note and Confluence page (links above) for shared artifacts. Marissa — can you take lead on SOW cadence?

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: install-checklist.xlsx
